message.name: InvestigationRequestV02
message.definition: Scope|The InvestigationRequest message is sent between agents or parties to create a payment or account related investigation or request a status update on an open payment or account related investigation.||Usage|The InvestigationRequest message can be used to create an investigation for these business scenarios -|- unable to apply;|- request for information;|- request value date adjustment;|- claim non-receipt;|- request debit authorisation;|- request use of funds;|- payment initiation not confirmed;|- miscellaenous business scenarios.|The InvestigationRequest message covers one and only one transaction or entry at a time in most business scenarios. In a request for information an agent or party may refer to more than one transaction within the Narrative element. For all other scenarios if an agent or party needs to create investigations that relate to several transactions or entries then several InvestigationRequest messages should be sent.

rules.name: StatusReasonRule
rules.text: If Reason/Code is equal to NARR, then AddititionalInformation must be present.

rules.name: ObjectionActionReasonRule
rules.text: If Action/Code is equal to RQOB for Request Objection, ActionReason must be present.

rules.name: ObjectionActionRule
rules.text: External code RQOB for Request Objection can only be populated in Action/Code when Requestor has already received a response from the Responder.

rules.name: IdentificationOrProxyPresenceRule
rules.text: Identification must be present or Proxy must be present. Both may be present.

rules.name: IdentificationAndProxyGuideline
rules.text: If the account identification is not defined through a conventional identification such as an email address or a mobile number, then the proxy element should be used for the identification of the account.

rules.name: ThirdReimbursementAgentRule
rules.text: If ThirdReimbursementAgent is present, then InstructingReimbursementAgent and InstructedReimbursementAgent must both be present.

rules.name: SettlementMethodAgentRule
rules.text: If SettlementMethod is equal to INDA or INGA, then ReimbursementAgent(s) and ClearingSystem are not allowed.

rules.name: SettlementMethodCoverRule
rules.text: If SettlementMethod is equal to COVE, then SettlementAccount and ClearingSystem are not allowed.

rules.name: SettlementMethodCoverAgentRule
rules.text: If SettlementMethod is equal to COVE, then InstructedReimbursementAgent or InstructingReimbursementAgent must be present.

rules.name: SettlementMethodClearingRule
rules.text: If SettlementMethod is equal to CLRG, then SettlementAccount and ReimbursementAgent(s) are not allowed.

rules.name: InstructingReimbursementAgentAccountRule
rules.text: If InstructingReimbursementAgentAccount is present, then InstructingReimbursementAgent must be present.

rules.name: InstructedReimbursementAgentAccountRule
rules.text: If InstructedReimbursementAgentAccount is present, then InstructedReimbursementAgent must be present.

rules.name: ThirdReimbursementAgentAccountRule
rules.text: If ThirdReimbursementAgentAccount is present, then ThirdReimbursementAgent must be present.

rules.name: AmendmentIndicatorTrueRule
rules.text: If AmendmentIndicator is true, then AmendmentInformationDetails must be present.

rules.name: AmendmentIndicatorFalseRule
rules.text: If AmendmentIndicator is false, then AmendmentInformationDetails is not allowed.

rules.name: OriginalIdentificationRule
rules.text: Either OriginalInstructionIdentification, OriginalEndToEndIdentification or OriginalUETR must be present.

rules.name: OriginalRequestedDateRule
rules.text: Either RequestedExecutionDate or RequestedCollectionDate must be present.

rules.name: OriginalIdentificationRule
rules.text: Either OriginalInstructionIdentification, OriginalEndToEndIdentification, OriginalTransactionIdentification or OriginalUETR must be present.

rules.name: OriginalStatementIdentificationOrEntryReferencePresenceRule
rules.text: OriginalStatementIdentification or OriginalEntryReference must be present, both may be present.

rules.name: ResponderInvestigationIdentificationGuideline
rules.text: Where the ResponderInvestigationIdentification has previously been provided to the requestor as part of an earlier response the ResponderInvestigationIdentification should be present.

rules.name: InvestigationReasonAndAdditionalRequestDataRule
rules.text: If Reason/Code is Narrative (NARR), then AdditionalRequestData must be present.

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: This component may not be used without the explicit approval of a SEG and submission to the RA of ISO 20022 compliant structure(s) to be used in the Envelope element.
